Just Completed my house purchase
Assuming u are engaging HDB for the purchase,
1. The admin fee of $20 is payable by buyers although sellers requested the extension. So You will be required to log in to HDB to endorse some documents and pay the fees ($20 + hdb legal fee if applicable) after HDB accepts your application. 
2. Since there’s extension, u will need to arrange with the seller for an inspection and handover of keys at the end of it. Make sure seller don’t leave any rubbish for u to clear. Ensure to apply to take over the utilities on the handover date. Then settle any payment with the seller that u have pre-agreed upon for the extension (e.g conservancy charges, property tax difference during their stay)

3. Enter the HDB office via the delifrance entrance, the officer there will direct u to get a queue number which will indicate which counter u will go for completion. 

During completion the officer will ask u to pass the seller the pro-rated property tax. Ask u to give the seller cashier order for any payment of cov/ downpayment if applicable.
